## Phase: 62 - Harden Hot-Cache Curation

### Why curation is the lever
from: [[decision:hot-cache-is-the-effective-retrieval-layer]] | [[decision:two-tier-curate-into-hot-cache]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- The always-loaded markdown hot cache IS the effective retrieval layer (P61 meta-finding); curation quality is the only memory/knowledge direction with affirmative evidence — marginal effort belongs here, not a runtime retrieval engine.
- "Caps need test assertions, not just documentation" (P55: session-start.sh's 70-line cap eroded to 137 over 30 phases, untested) — the direct motivation for a deterministic curator + invariant test on this mandatory file.

### Live-file facts that shape the curator
from: [[decision:dedup-key-proposition-not-slug]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- The dedup-by-source-slug rule is wrong-when-followed: distinct facts legitimately share a source phase — `phase-45` has 6 distinct entries under one slug (live proof). Dedup MUST key on normalized proposition text; exact-dup merge keeps the higher `uses`.
- The usage counter is empirically inert (87/100 entries at `[uses:1]`, increments only on exact source re-cite), so eviction degenerates to recency among the floor. The cap-enforce is still deterministic-and-safe; a better value signal is an open (non-blocking) question.

### Build discipline
from: [[decision:harden-hot-cache-curation-deterministic]] | [[decision:curator-fail-safe-atomic]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- Deterministic validators at boundaries over neural judges — the invariant test IS the validation; NO reasoning-eval (distillation-quality is unmeasurable by the binary runner + no headroom, so it's OUT of scope; subtraction-test, like Phase 59's CUT research).
- High blast radius (cp -r to every project) ⇒ fail-safe: atomic validate-temp→rename (abort byte-intact), whole-file no-op + warn on any malformed pairing (never per-entry repair), and `[pinned]` is eviction-immune (pins win over cap with a warning).
